data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for MyID identity verification SDK supporting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides native integration with the MyID service for user identification and face detection. Handles camera capture, document scanning, and user verification flows on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to verify user identity via the MyID service in your mobile app.
You require face detection and capture capabilities integrated with native MyID SDKs.
avoid_when: You are building a web or desktop application (supports Android and iOS only).
You need general-purpose authentication like OAuth or social logins.
strengths: Supports both identification and face detection entry types.
Provides extensive customization options for appearance and organization details on iOS and Android.
Includes Huawei Mobile Services (HMS) integration support.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration such as iOS Podfile updates and Info.plist permissions.
Tied directly to the proprietary MyID backend service and its session parameters.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting platform target to iOS 13.0, adding camera usage description in Info.plist, and optionally adding the Huawei Integrity SDK for HMS devices.
